agency.name: Haris Travel Agency
agency.heroSubtitle: From air tickets and Umrah to honeymoons and corporate travel, Haris Travel Agency plans every trip with clear pricing and a real person beside you, from Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Karachi to the world.
agency.aboutLead: Haris Travel Agency is a customer-focused travel agency providing reliable and convenient travel solutions for individuals, families, business travelers, and groups. We make travel planning simple, comfortable, transparent, and memorable.
agency.ownerQuote: Every traveler deserves honest advice and a team that stays reachable. I am committed to your satisfaction, professional travel assistance, and transparent pricing, and I want to be the agent your family comes back to for every trip.

services.title: Air Tickets
services.shortDesc: Domestic and international tickets on all major airlines.
services.priceBadge: Send route and dates for the best fare
inclusions: Emirates, PIA, Turkish Airlines, Qatar Airways, Etihad, Saudia and more

services.title: Holiday & Tour Packages
services.shortDesc: Ready and customised packages with hotels, transfers and sightseeing.
services.priceBadge: Tap a country in Destinations for the full itinerary
inclusions: UK, Canada and USA on request

services.title: Hotel Reservations
services.shortDesc: Hotels matched to your budget, location and travel dates.

services.title: Visa Assistance
services.shortDesc: Guidance and document preparation for your visa application.
inclusions: Canada and Italy – full process from PKR 185,000

services.title: Umrah Package – Makkah & Madinah (15 Days)
services.shortDesc: A complete Umrah journey with comfortable stays and guided ziyarat.
itinerary: Day 1: Flight to Saudi Arabia, transfer and check-in at Madinah hotel
Days 2 – 6: Madinah – Masjid an-Nabawi, Rawdah visit, ziyarat of Uhud, Quba and Qiblatain
Day 7: Travel to Makkah, wear Ihram at Miqat and perform Umrah
Days 8 – 13: Makkah – prayers at Masjid al-Haram, ziyarat of Jabal al-Noor, Arafat, Mina and Muzdalifah, optional extra Umrah
Day 14: Farewell Tawaf
Day 15: Transfer to airport, return flight

destinations.name: Dubai
destinations.title: Dubai – 7 Days
destinations.shortDesc: City of skyscrapers, desert adventure and shopping, ideal for families and couples.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival, hotel check-in, Dubai Marina & JBR evening walk
Day 2: Old Dubai – Al Fahidi, Gold & Spice Souk, abra ride on the Creek
Day 3: Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall & Fountain show
Day 4: Desert safari with BBQ dinner
Day 5: Abu Dhabi day trip – Sheikh Zayed Mosque, Corniche
Day 6: Museum of the Future / Global Village (seasonal) & shopping
Day 7: Free morning, airport drop-off
destinations.priceText: Price on request (season, hotel & group size par depend karta hai)

destinations.name: Australia
destinations.title: Australia – 8 Days Sydney, Melbourne & Gold Coast
destinations.shortDesc: Experience iconic Sydney landmarks, Melbourne culture, and Gold Coast theme parks and beaches.
itinerary: Day 1: Arrival at Sydney International Airport, private transfer to hotel, Darling Harbour evening walk
Day 2: Sydney City Tour – Sydney Opera House, Sydney Harbour Bridge, The Rocks & Bondi Beach
Day 3: Full-day Blue Mountains tour, Scenic World cable car, Three Sisters lookout & wildlife park
Day 4: Domestic flight to Melbourne, check-in, Federation Square & Yarra River cruise
Day 5: Great Ocean Road full-day adventure – 12 Apostles, Loch Ard Gorge & coastal rainforest
Day 6: Flight to Gold Coast, Surfers Paradise beach, evening waterfront dining
Day 7: Warner Bros. Movie World theme park or Sea World Marine Park tour
Day 8: Souvenir shopping, transfer to Gold Coast / Brisbane airport & departure flight
inclusions: 4-Star hotel accommodation with daily buffet breakfast
All airport transfers and inter-city transport
Domestic flights within Australia (Sydney - Melbourne - Gold Coast)
Blue Mountains and Great Ocean Road guided day tours with tickets
Theme park entry tickets at Gold Coast
Complete Australia tourist visa guidance and document file preparation

Day 7: Return to KL / departure
